$description: Every role a component may use. Structural roles come from the LCARS lab; semantic roles alias them by default, and a theme may point one elsewhere. minContrast is against bg, per theme and mode.

ink.$description: Text on a colored shape: labels on blocks, pills and bars.

frame.$description: Elbows, top and bottom bars. Never carries text.

block.$description: Sidebar blocks and buttons. Carries ink.

accent.$description: Code bars, tabs, titles and headings.

meter-off.$description: Empty meter segments and quiet readouts.

alert.$description: Error state only, always paired with text.

focus.$description: The lit focus ring in the gap.

data.$description: Numbers in a data cascade or readout.

data-hi.$description: The highlighted number in a cascade.

display.$description: Display text set on the page, such as headings. The accent in dark schemes; light schemes darken the frame.

unlit.$description: The block color of an off component.

label-ink.$description: Text on a lit label block.

emphasis-ink.$description: Label text that must read louder than label-ink, such as on an alert block.

muted.$description: Value color of an off component, and low-priority readouts.

ok.$description: Healthy, approved or passing. Never green.

dim.$description: The dark phase of a blink: each channel of the lit color times this factor.

dim-snap.$description: After dimming, round each channel to the nearest multiple of this fraction of full range (0.2 is 0x33 of 0xff), so dimmed colors stay on the palette grid.

blink-period.$description: How long each phase of a blink lasts: lit for one period, dimmed for the next.
